page.content:
Lloyd Webber / Eliot musical that took the long-run crown at the Winter Garden.

How Cats connects

  • Location: Winter Garden Theatre — Cats ran at the Winter Garden Theatre for eighteen years.
  • Work: A Chorus Line — Cats took Broadway's longest-run record from A Chorus Line.
  • Work: The Phantom of the Opera — The Phantom of the Opera later passed Cats as Broadway's longest-running show.

What is Cats?

Cats is the junkyard-cats musical that opened at the Winter Garden in 1982, ran for eighteen years, and briefly held Broadway's longest-run record after A Chorus Line.

Key threads lead to Winter Garden Theatre, A Chorus Line and The Phantom of the Opera.
